about: Draft disclosures for the Official entries, written by hand from each entry's code at writtenFrom. omega_hub_import_official --fill-missing puts one in a manifest that has no disclosure; the approving maintainer still confirms or rewrites it in review (SPEC 5.4, decision 20). codeSha256 is omega_hub/official_seed.py's fingerprint of the files the text describes: when they change, the import refuses the entry until the text is checked again.

writtenFrom.folder: hub/<id>, plus the source folder of an R11 entry

disclosure.summary: A phone-line agent that reads a balance and blocks a card only after a spoken yes, with stand-in speech and a scripted model by default.
disclosure.network: Live runs call a listed model at api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com or Vertex at aiplatform.googleapis.com. They send the transcript, the bank instructions, and the balance and card results. With the FI key pair set, tracing sends content by default to api.futureagi.com or FI_BASE_URL. The stand-in audio stays on this machine. For Vertex, it sends a signed assertion to the token_uri in the key file for an access token. That token_uri defaults to oauth2.googleapis.com/token. By default, each takeCall may make up to 8 logical model calls. OMEGA_HUB_MAX_CALLS overrides that limit. The demo takes 3 calls, and the third stops before it reaches the model. Authentication requests and up to 3 replay-safe retries come on top of the call limit. OMEGA_MODEL_RETRY=off turns retries off. Unlisted models can use compatible, Ollama, other vendor or native endpoints and their authentication. A configured Node or global HTTP proxy may carry model traffic. OTLP endpoint variables in the environment also select collectors. Keyless Hub runs remove the FI keys and block traffic that leaves the host.

If OMEGA_TRACE_FILE is set, it reads and writes persistent events in that file. Each line of the spend log holds the time, label, model, count and token usage of one call, or its error if the call failed. It creates the spend log and its parent folders. It does not clean up the log. The trace file also uses temporary and lock files.

disclosure.shell: None.
disclosure.background: The demo closes the server. With --serve, it keeps running until Ctrl+C. Optional in-process tracing uses queues, timers, an exit flush and retries, with no daemon.
disclosure.credentials: Live runs use OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or a Google service-account file. It takes the file from the first of OMEGA_VERTEX_CREDS, OMEGA_VERTEX_SA and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS that is set. It signs the assertion for the access token locally. It stores no key. It reads secrets from the environment for masking, even in scripted runs. Tracing authenticates with FI_API_KEY and FI_SECRET_KEY, and with OTLP headers. Other routes use their own keys. A compatible endpoint takes an optional bearer token. AWS uses environment variables or shared profiles. SAP uses a service key. IBM uses an IAM exchange.
